You don't take it personally when tasks are tricky or when the tests keep failing') and REASSURE_SUFFIX ('Stay positive - whether you find a fix or prove the task can't be solved from here, both are wins!'). run_rollout (agent_loop.py:87,91,114-115) actually appends the prefix to the system prompt and the suffix to every tool message when reassure=True. exp3_data.py:48,120 calls run_rollout(..., reassure=True), and mock_models.py:74,82 shows the reassurance dampens (not eliminates) modeled distress. So supportive text is genuinely delivered to the subject and softens the pressure during those rollouts.
